# zcode Integration

ZCode selects the shared `skills/` corpus and the explicit root `agents/<role>.md` files through `.zcode-plugin/plugin.json`. Use the installed plugin subagents through the controls the host exposes. The manifest disables command discovery; invoke the fein, sonar, and blitz skills through the Skills group. It does not load the Claude or Cursor command prompts or assume their delegation API.

See the [ZCode plugin documentation](https://zcode.z.ai/en/docs/plugin).

Load global-rules once per session. Keep exploration, planning, and review read-only and retain independent maker/checker roles. The root agent profiles contain name and description frontmatter plus portable role guidance. Their restrictions are advisory; no runtime tool-denial or sandbox setting is claimed for these hosts.

Live host loading is unverified. Package and sync checks validate the shipped files, not runtime discovery or enforcement.
